title: Household stock
subtitle: Use items with the shortest shelf life first.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters.
validation.nameMax: Name must be at most 255 characters.

estimateBasis.title: Estimate basis: about {{count}} days
estimateBasis.disclaimer: This is a category-based planning reminder, not a food-safety guarantee. Follow the package label and do not consume food when its condition is doubtful.

buah_segar.storage: Store according to the fruit type; keep fast-ripening fruit separate from other produce.
buah_segar.useBy: Check for changes in texture, smell, or mould before use.

sayur_hijau.storage: Refrigerate and keep dry until ready to use.
sayur_hijau.useBy: Use first when leaves begin to wilt or feel damp.

sayur_umbi.storage: Keep in a cool, dry, ventilated place away from excess moisture.
sayur_umbi.useBy: Discard when there is mould, an unusual smell, or decay.

roti_tanpa_pengawet.storage: Keep sealed; move to the freezer when it will not be used soon.
roti_tanpa_pengawet.useBy: Do not merely remove a mouldy spot—avoid the whole loaf when mould is visible.

telur_lepas.storage: Refrigerate at a stable temperature and avoid repeated temperature changes.
telur_lepas.useBy: Use according to local storage rules and condition; do not use cracked or odorous eggs.

daging_segar.storage: Keep covered in the coldest part of the refrigerator and prevent juices touching other food.
daging_segar.useBy: Cook or freeze promptly; do not use when condition or smell is doubtful.

daging_beku.storage: Keep continuously frozen and avoid repeated thaw-freeze cycles.
daging_beku.useBy: This window is mainly for quality; thaw safely before use.

ikan_segar.storage: Keep very cold, covered, and use as soon as possible.
ikan_segar.useBy: Do not use when smell, colour, or texture is doubtful.

susu_segar_non_uht.storage: Keep refrigerated and return it promptly after use.
susu_segar_non_uht.useBy: Follow the package date when available; discard when packaging is damaged or condition changes.

keju_segar.storage: Keep covered in the refrigerator and use clean serving utensils.
keju_segar.useBy: Check product condition and follow package directions before use.

default_unknown.storage: Use the package instructions or guidance specific to the product type.
default_unknown.useBy: This date is only an initial reminder; check product condition before use.

emptyState.title: Track Your Household Items
emptyState.description: Take a photo of your groceries or add items manually. Expirely will track expiry dates and remind you before items go to waste.

recommendation.resultsIntro: Choose an idea, then mark only the ingredients you actually used.

onboardingTour.recommendDescription: Get AI ideas for items approaching their expiry date.
